beat: Saturday evening: Raj–Sharmi dinner preparation and Dhika changes outfit

lines.original: It was evening 6 PM and John and Pappu were waiting patiently for Dhika to get dresed so that they all can leave for dinner at Raj and Sharmi's........
lines.local: Shaam ke 6 baje John aur Pappu patiently wait kar rahe the ki Dhika tayyar ho aur sab Raj–Sharmi ke ghar dinner par niklein.

lines.original: Hearing the bedroom door open... both John and Pappu turned together to see.... in sync
lines.local: Bedroom ka darwaza khulte hi John aur Pappu ne ek saath mudkar dekha.

lines.original: Dhika was ready, dressed in a beautiful saree looking gorgeous as ever... she came out looking at John smiling.....
lines.local: Dhika bahut sundar saree pehne taiyaar thi aur John ko muskuraakar dekhti hui bahar aayi.

lines.original: But John started laughing out loud.....
lines.local: Magar John zor-zor se hans pada.
John: Hahahaha, Dhika... phir se saree!

lines.original: Dhika: giving him an angry look.... what?
lines.local: Dhika gusse waali nazar se: Kya?

lines.original: John: my sweet little wife.... you always dress like going to temple or to college..... hehe
lines.local: John: Meri pyari chhoti wife, tum hamesha mandir ya college jaane jaisi dress pehenti ho. Hehe.

lines.original: Dhika immediately got child like angry at him..... turning back furiously, she went into the room and shut the door with a bang....
lines.local: Dhika bachchon jaisi gusse mein ekdam palti, bedroom mein gayi aur darwaza zor se band kiya.

lines.original: After about 20 minutes..... she came out and stood in front of him....
lines.local: Takreeban bees minute baad woh dobara bahar aayi aur John ke saamne khadi ho gayi.
John: Wowww... ab yeh hua na!

lines.original: Dhika: shhhh.... no wow for you today.....she put a finger on his lips.... teasing.....
lines.local: Dhika uske honton par ungli rakhkar: Shhh, aaj tumhare liye koi 'wow' nahi!

lines.original: First time, Dhika is wearing such a dress to go outside......in fact, this is the first time, she is wearing it at all.....
lines.local: Pehli baar Dhika aisi dress pehenkar bahar jaa rahi thi; sach toh yeh ki pehli baar ise pehna bhi tha.

lines.original: John was surprised to see her wearing this dress, by herself to go out, that too to Raj's house.....
lines.local: John hairaan tha ki woh apni marzi se aisi dress pehenkar, woh bhi Raj ke ghar, jaa rahi hai.

lines.original: It was a 20 minutes drive from Dhika's place to Sharmi's house... Since Pappu was on John's hands and him not wanting to come down.... Dhika took the wheel.... She is fond of cars and always enjoyed driving their Octavia, which she rarely got to, with Pappu always jumping on her.
lines.local: Dhika ke ghar se Sharmi tak drive bees minute ki thi. Pappu John ki godi mein tha aur utarna nahi chahta tha, isliye Dhika ne khud Octavia chalaayi. Use gaadiyan bahut pasand thi aur drive karna bhi, magar Pappu aksar uski taraf kud jaata, isliye mauka kam milta tha.

lines.original: Raj is rich and has built a big house with all his desires and tastes added to it; it was a three floored house.......Dhika has seen the house from outside, while dropping Sharmi after college but never had time to go inside.. They only moved in here a month or so ago....
lines.local: Raj ne apni pasand ke hisaab se bada, teen-manazila ghar banwaaya tha. Dhika Sharmi ko college ke baad chhodte hue ghar bahar se dekh chuki thi, magar andar kabhi nahi gayi thi. Lagbhag mahina bhar pehle hi woh yahaan shift hue the.

lines.original: The gate for the big house was open when they reached and so Dhika went in straight without stopping... when they got out of the car, she noticed two of her favorite cars standing in the garage..... Mini Cooper and a BWM GT. Anyway it was already late and so, she proceeded straight to the main door along with John and Pappu...
lines.local: Khula gate dekh Dhika bina ruke car andar le gayi. Utarte waqt garage mein apni do favorite cars—Mini Cooper aur BMW GT—dekhin. Der ho rahi thi toh John aur Pappu ke saath seedha main door par chal di.
